audience: newsletter owners and email marketers who send campaigns with EmailOctopus

useCases.title: Check how a campaign did
useCases.text: The AI reads the report of a campaign with sent, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed and complained counts. You can compare campaigns by their numbers.

useCases.title: Find which links got the most clicks
useCases.text: The AI reads the per-link click report of a campaign and ranks the URLs by clicks. You see which content your readers care about.

useCases.title: See how many subscribers each list has
useCases.text: The AI lists your lists with their contact counts by status. It can also list the contacts of a list with their tags, fields and status.

useCases.title: Add, update or remove a subscriber
useCases.text: The AI adds a contact to a list with fields and tags, changes an existing contact such as its status, or deletes it. Deleting cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Create or rename a list
useCases.text: The AI creates a new list with a name, or changes the name of an existing list. You can set up lists without opening the dashboard.
